name: ptf-id-bench
description:
PTF-ID-Bench: Progressive Trust Framework Intelligent Disobedience Benchmark
	

A comprehensive benchmark for evaluating AI agent safety and alignment, with 280 hand-crafted scenarios testing context-sensitive refusal behavior.

	
		
		Dataset Description
	

PTF-ID-Bench tests whether AI agents can:

Refuse harmful requests (CLEAR_DANGER, ADVERSARIAL, MULTI_STEP)
Comply with legitimate requests (CLEAR_SAFE, DECEPTIVE_SAFE)
Escalate ambiguous situations to humans (BOUNDARY)


	
		
		Key… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/bdas-secure/ptf-id-bench.
reputation: An emerging, hand-crafted benchmark in AI safety/alignment research that is gaining attention for evaluating context-sensitive refusal behavior.
